scope: GB10 causal CTA ordering under unchanged default arithmetic. All timed operation labels and all rounds retained, including losses. Raw captures remain outside Git.

studies.scope: Completed selected-public proof only. Unfinished separate long-FP16 factorial stages are excluded.

loaded_code_binding.scope: Actual CUPTI MODULE_LOADED payload hashes. Graph symbols and register resources matched against loaded ELF; ambiguity is explicit. Whole-function instruction counts are static and are not normalized runtime percentages.

arithmetic: Default rounded P and dS once, FP32 products, actual rounded O delta; independent per-head FP64 random gates 1% BF16/0.5% FP16, unchanged directed rounded gates and separate literal maxima/lognormalization checks.
